findings.title: Job admission does not bind the recorded marker SHA to the bytes verified, and lacks final all-role derived-file rebinding
findings.actual: Real D full-role admission returned PASS/fresh_original_source_context_and_all_selected_role_checks=true after first head was changed during last role validation. Subsequent original cache.verify_role rejected the first role with selected checkpoint head bits changed. A second real D probe changed complete.json to {} after verify_role returned: line47 recorded the SHA of those unverified corrupt bytes and returned PASS; later original verifier rejected unexpected cache completion fields. c.check(full=True) binds original context inputs but not already-checked derived output files.
findings.expected: A PASS must refer to the same marker/derived-cache bytes whose complete validity was checked and must reject earlier role drift observed before aggregate return/publication. A changed file must not become a fresh accepted SHA merely because it is hashed after validation.
findings.recommendation: Capture exact selected derived namespace and marker/file bindings before the expensive verifier, prove the relevant bytes/inventory are unchanged afterward, then rebind the full selected role set and source/context/code pins at the aggregate publication boundary. Validate/recompute original heads and the already-required chunk/metadata/hash contract. Apply finalizer in admit_contexts and before admit_job publication/reuse. Reuse current source validation; do not repeat original image/model work merely to close derived-cache binding.

findings.title: Source9 collector and 45/180 closure/consumer can publish or return stale aggregate success/zero remaining writes
findings.actual: Both positive tiny collector corpora passed (exact9 and45/180, including healthy validate_feature_capacity==0). In separate drift probes, changing the first head after the last real owned_role check still published source9 status PASS and real_source_only_GPU_qualification_passed=true, or capacity PASS_OWNED_45MODEL_180ROLE_FORMATS_ZERO_SCHEDULED_FEATURE_WRITES with future_scheduled_feature_write_bytes=0. A healthy saved closure plus drift during the consumer own180-role sweep also passed saved==fresh and returned0. In every case the original owned_role immediately rejected the currently corrupt first head. The newly added consumer correctly catches preexisting changes but its fresh regeneration has the same aggregate drift gap.
findings.expected: Collector PASS and capacity0 may be emitted only after an end-of-sweep rebind of all checked owned formats and bound owner/worker/input/code evidence. The consumer must use the same invariant before returning zero. This remains a format/producer/future-write statement, not scientific/data acceptance.
findings.recommendation: Share a final aggregate rebind used by source collector, _feature_capacity_report, publication and validate_feature_capacity; capture verified bindings before/after per-role checking so the final pass compares against already-verified bytes. Source9 must rebind required payload checksums plus all heads/manifests/markers/chunk metadata and pins; capacity may retain its explicitly disclosed content_checksums=False scope but must rebind its entire format/header/head/ownership contract. Recheck externally bound stage/worker refs and code at final consumption/publication. If ordinary cooperating writers can remain active, acquire their established locks or require a quiescent append-only stage; do not claim an arbitrary hostile-filesystem atomic snapshot.
